title: #[non_exhaustive] on all public types — correct future-proofing, must defend
description: Every public struct and enum in this crate carries #[non_exhaustive]. A future contributor may suggest removing it to allow exhaustive matching or struct update syntax. Do not. #[non_exhaustive] is essential here: (1) RFC 8621 defines these wire types and the IANA registries for roles and keywords grow over time; (2) new fields added to Email, Mailbox, etc. must not be breaking changes for downstream crates; (3) MailboxRole::Other already depends on it being non-exhaustive. Removing it would force semver-major on every field addition.
